title: Subset Count OQ-02: Multiset Powerset Cardinality

problemStatement.formal: For a finite multiset s, prove that the cardinality of its powerset is 2 ^ card(s), and prove corresponding fixed-size powerset-cardinality facts.
problemStatement.plain: Backfills metadata for the multiset subset-counting formalization. The Lean file proves powerset cardinalities for multisets, fixed-size choices, the empty and cons cases, and the bridge back to Finset powersets.
whyMatters: Counting subsets is a basic combinatorial identity used throughout finite mathematics.
The multiset formulation captures repeated elements and fixed-size choices directly.
The Finset bridge makes the result useful for ordinary finite-set counting entries.

proven: `multiset_powerset_card` proves that a multiset powerset has cardinality 2 ^ card(s).
`powerset_empty_card` and `powerset_cons_card` record the base and cons recursion cases.
`finset_powerset_via_multiset` transfers the result to Finset powersets.
`mem_powerset_iff` states the membership characterization for submultisets.
`SubsetCountOQ02.lean` is recorded with 0 axioms and 0 sorries.
open: Generating-function and q-analogue subset-counting variants are outside this finite powerset-count slice.
knownResults.goal: Make the proved multiset powerset and choose-cardinality results searchable.
